rules.reason: wait() is deprecated and throttled unpredictably.
rules.use: task.wait()

rules.reason: spawn() is deprecated and runs on an unpredictable delay.
rules.use: task.spawn()

rules.reason: delay() is deprecated, same as wait/spawn.
rules.use: task.delay()

rules.reason: The second Instance.new argument (parent) fires property-changed listeners before the object is configured.
rules.use: Set properties first, set Parent last.

rules.reason: Body movers are deprecated and behave differently from their replacements.
rules.use: LinearVelocity, AlignPosition, AlignOrientation (they behave differently; retest).

rules.reason: Lowercase :connect() is the deprecated Roblox event API.
rules.use: :Connect()

rules.reason: FilteringEnabled is always on; checking it is dead code from pre-2018 tutorials.
rules.use: Drop the check.

rules.reason: FindPartOnRay is deprecated.
rules.use: workspace:Raycast() with a RaycastParams.

rules.reason: Humanoid:LoadAnimation is deprecated.
rules.use: Animator:LoadAnimation() on the Humanoid's Animator.

rules.reason: SetPrimaryPartCFrame is deprecated and ignores welds.
rules.use: Model:PivotTo()

rules.reason: Player:GetMouse() is legacy input and does not work well with touch or gamepad.
rules.use: UserInputService or ContextActionService.

rules.reason: Gotham is the tutorial default and reads as an unstyled placeholder.
rules.use: One chosen display font plus one body font, set in a theme module.

rules.reason: Frame + UICorner + UIGradient + UIStroke is the code-shape glass look every model draws by default.
rules.use: Panels and buttons as uploaded 9-slice images; code only places them.

rules.reason: Emoji as icons is the cheapest icon a model can type.
rules.use: An own icon set, one style, uploaded as decals.

rules.reason: SetAsync has no retry and can silently overwrite concurrent writes.
rules.use: UpdateAsync with retries, BindToClose, and a session lock (or ProfileStore).

rules.reason: rbxassetid://0 is a placeholder that ships as a blank or grey box.
rules.use: The real uploaded asset id.

rules.reason: Anti-cheat checks and :Kick() in a LocalScript run on the client, where an exploiter controls the code.
rules.use: Checks live on the server only.

rules.reason: A ProcessReceipt handler that never returns NotProcessedYet loses purchases made while the server was down or errored.
rules.use: Return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet on a failed grant so Roblox retries.

rules.reason: A DataStore with no BindToClose loses the last write when the server shuts down.
rules.use: game:BindToClose() that saves before the server closes.

rules.reason: A remote handler with no typeof() check trusts whatever type the client sends.
rules.use: typeof() every argument before using it.
